titulo.estudio: Comparer des sources : Repérer les informations

intro: Contrast data that match and differ in two sources about the same event. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

frases.estudio: Le journal municipal affirme que 62 % des habitants utilisent le parc chaque semaine.
frases.alumno: The municipal newspaper claims that 62% of residents use the park every week.

frases.estudio: Une enquête publiée en juin donne 55 %, mais elle interroge uniquement les résidents du centre.
frases.alumno: A survey published in June gives 55%, but it only asks residents of the centre.

texto: Contrast data that match and differ in two sources about the same event. Separate the fact from its context: verb tenses, connectors and who says what show when and by whom each piece of information is given.
Watch out: tell apart source, date and scope; two texts can use different figures because they measure different periods. In this passage, «enquête» means «survey».
